images.caption: Figure 1:Complex graphic generation from a concise user request.The examples illustrate differences in content, composition, and text rendering across generation configurations.MOSS-Imagecombines a pretrained diffusion transformer with prompt enhancement and optional explicit layout specifications. The proprietary output provides a visual reference; quantitative comparisons are reported in Section5.

Figure 2:Overview of MOSS-Image.An intent-aware prompt enhancer constructs content and layout specifications from user requests, and a pretrained 5B single-stream DiT renders them into images through a shared text-conditioning interface. The right panel details the renderer’s joint self-attention and gated feed-forward components.

Figure 3:Pretraining recipe of MOSS-Image.(a) After deduplication and AI-image removal, we keep all images and caption their artifacts instead of filtering them out. (b) A ReLAION sample with its original caption, three recaptions, and layout JSON (excerpts); the JSON’s object and text boxes are drawn in orange and blue. Visible text, marked in blue, is transcribed verbatim, line breaks () included. (c) Maximum tokens per sample in each stage.

Figure 4:Human preference onRLA: (a) generators under shared enhanced natural-language prompts; (b) prompt strategies; and (c) end-to-end systems. Bars show Bradley–Terry ratings on an Elo scale with asymptotic 95% confidence intervals. Ratings are fitted separately for the three comparison groups.
Figure 5:Early data-filtering comparison.Curves show recorded checkpoint scores without smoothing. FDR6-LAION is the minimum over the recorded CFG sweep. Each curve represents one training run.

header: Appendix JLine-Break Alignment: Denoising Case Study

images.caption: Figure 9:Line-break conditioning during denoising.Top: prompt with explicit line breaks. Bottom: prompt without line breaks. Each column shows the same denoising step, progressing from left to right; labels give the step number and post-update noise levelσ\sigma. Explicit line breaks help the character content of each line become recognizable earlier, with clearer text in the final displayed step.

images.caption: Figure 10:Generalization to a resolution unseen during training.(a) Lower-resolution comparison.
